narrative.details:
<The scrap of note is mostly illegible. What is still readable, however, are notes about preparations for an offering.

An offering stone is mentioned, as well as a ritual.

Perhaps you can find this offering stone nearby.>
narrative.objectives: Find the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Strange implements and items litter the rough surface of the stone.This is surely the offering stone that is mentioned in the note.>
